introduction: Pennsylvania weatherization helps eligible households reduce energy waste and improve home comfort. Local providers deliver services in every county.
description: Pennsylvania weatherization helps eligible households reduce energy waste and improve home comfort. Local providers deliver services in every county.

sections.who: The current income guideline is 200% of federal poverty. Certain SSI, TANF, LIHEAP and qualifying housing-program households have an automatic eligibility route.
sections.get: Approved home energy improvements are services rather than a general-purpose cash payment. The provider determines appropriate measures.
sections.docs:
• Income or qualifying benefit evidence.
  • Household and property information.
  • Any owner or landlord permission the provider requests.
sections.apply:
1. Find your provider

    Use the local-provider links on DCED Weatherization.

  2. Ask for intake

    Confirm the checklist and current scheduling.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss property access, safety conditions and approved work.
sections.after: Eligibility does not itself specify an installation date. Keep in touch with the local provider about the work plan.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DCED weatherization; Current eligibility. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is this the same as a heating grant?
No. Weatherization improves home energy efficiency.
DCED lists providers covering all Pennsylvania counties.
Certain means-tested benefits provide an automatic eligibility route.
The provider assesses what the home needs under program rules.
